dek: The following is issued on behalf of the Hong Kong Monetary Authority: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) released today (August 14) the key analytical accounts of the Exchange Fund at the end of July 2026. Foreign assets, representing the external assets of the Exchange Fund, increased during the month by HK$13.8
